title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: MSP-0 is MERGED to main as 12053dc (squash, so 3806be0 is not an ancestor - normal). That exhausts what step 6 can currently land; MSP-1 and every collapse MSP stay blocked on absent preconditions (0126). Next session opens with the hooksPath capture race (0131), then re-plans which precondition to fund.
spine.next_step: FIRST, before any precondition work, per 0131: fix the continuity plugin's hooksPath capture race - it can record its own managed dir as continuity.priorHooksPath, so the chain self-references and silently skips .githooks/pre-commit, the full npm gate. Healthy right now (prior=.githooks): latent, not broken. Close stale task_70509bf0; fold it into task_21df6527. Open sub-decision is fail-loud vs the bootstrap trap. THEN re-plan the precondition - step 1.5 cheapest, step 3 unblocks most.
open_risks: A false-clean gate is worse than no gate. MSP-0's first draft had three reproduced false-clean paths plus a tautological test asserting the guarantee it lacked (0130). Review every later gate MSP (6, 7, 8, 9) adversarially with reproduced probes - never on green tests alone.

NAMED RESIDUAL in the merged gate: a phase key built by concatenation (['pha'+'se']) reads clean, since no text gate sees it without constant folding. The literal ['phase'] form halts. Zero occurrences today.

parallel-plan-execution.js has the SAME defect MSP-0 fixed: it declares Final review, nothing uses it. The gate halts fail-closed (exit 42) there because that file delegates phase into run-engine.mjs - declaration and use in different files. Needs a CROSS-FILE gate mode, not another target path.

MSP-1 stays BLOCKED (0126) and cannot be unblocked inside step 6: .mitosis/run.json records no timestamp, dispatch count, wall-clock or phase entry. Step 3 owns the journal. All three section-14 performance claims stay UNMEASURED; 0115's falsifiers stay unpayable.
Four of five hard preconditions are NOT-LANDED, one PARTIAL. Collapse MSPs 2, 3, 4, 5, 8 and 11 rest on capability that does not exist - a defect in the plan as carried, not in the architecture.

Spec anchors are POISON: 0128 found every citation measured against a dirty tree of another branch, and MSP-0 confirmed it - all five anchors had moved. Re-derive against the live tree per MSP; never pass the spec's numbers to an implementer.

The spec OMITS required collateral edits. MSP-0 needed frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:489 updated (it pinned the old Shepherd name) or the branch would be red. Grep for tests pinning any renamed string BEFORE dispatching a rename MSP.
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} is held for per-write human approval, so implementers cannot be fanned out unattended. Plan interactive approval.

mirror-guard.test.mjs's twin array at :19 covers ONLY modules inlined verbatim inside mitosis.js; standalone CLI siblings are correctly absent. A new standalone lib module needs no dual edit - verified for mitosis-gate.mjs.

task_70509bf0 is RUNNING in a separate user-started session against a premise that no longer holds (it believes the pre-commit gate is dead; it self-healed). Close it rather than act on its output. 0131 folds its real residue into task_21df6527.

Six other paused mitosis threads still need explicit per-thread disposition.
out_of_scope: Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary and durability model against a machine-checkable oracle.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120: edges derive from a deterministic verb driving LSP over a seeded project.
Cluster-aware scheduling, and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - real defects, but they change the scheduler and step 3 respectively; spec section 1 fences both out.
Executing the run-readiness-repair spec's 11 MSPs or quiescent-advance M0-M8, pending per-thread disposition. Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving that branch without a PR is fine. No longer an open item.
